title: GitHub Desktop Simplified Chinese Patch Index
description: Schema for the index.json file listing available Chinese localization patches for GitHub Desktop.

version.description: Exact GitHub Desktop version this patch applies to.

url.description: URL to download the zip patch file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the zip file.

size.description: Size of the zip file in bytes.

compat.description: Optional list of compatible GitHub Desktop versions. If omitted, only exact version match is allowed.
